segments.text: In this meditation, we will be activating the power of pure desire within us.
But what is a pure desire?
We have wants and we have desires.
Wants are ephemeral.
They come and go and they're usually simply your ego's reaction to something from around you or an idea you have.
But desires are something deeper.
They're that part of you that wants to find your truest, innermost self, the true meaning of yourself.
And that part which wants to reach its highest potential spiritually.
We have a simple mechanism within us which can activate this power of pure desire.
And we will now do several exercises to activate this mechanism.
Start by sitting comfortably with your back straight and take a couple of deep breaths.
Close your eyes and allow your attention to settle within.
Open both of your hands out onto your lap with your palms facing upwards.
In these meditations, we work on our central nervous system, which is split into three channels, the left, the right, and the center.
The left and the right channels correspond to our sympathetic nervous system, which is responsible for all of our fight or flight actions.
And our parasympathetic nervous system corresponds to the central channel.
When the central channel is activated, this is when we can fully relax within.
Today we will be working on the left channel as the left channel corresponds to our power of desire.
Bring your attention to the left side of your body. Just observe how you may be feeling.
Is there any weight or tension anywhere in the left side of your body?
How do you feel in your left hand? Is it hot or cool? Tingling slightly? Just observe.
Now we will use our kundalini energy to cleanse this left channel.
Keep your left hand open on your lap and place your right hand on the ground if you are sitting on the ground or just towards the ground if you are seated upon a chair.
Just as our body is made up of all of the elements, we can use the elements to cleanse ourselves within.
Now we will use the earth element to cleanse our left channel.
Bring your attention to the left side of your body again.
Now you can ask sincerely within, addressing your kundalini energy,
Mother Kundalini please cleanse my left channel. Please remove all worldly desires from within me which do not benefit my spiritual growth.
Please take away all materialistic selfish desires which bring my state down, which take me away from my true self.
Mother Kundalini please take away all impurities from my left channel. Now you can place your right hand over your left hip.
Where the leg meets the body. Here you can once again express the desire to truly know yourself
and be connected to your spirit so that you can start to feel what is really beneficial for your
spirit, what is a pure desire. Ask within, Mother Kundalini please give me the knowledge
of my true self. Mother Kundalini please allow me to experience the nature of my spirit.
Next, you can bring your right hand upwards a couple of inches so that it rests over the left side of your stomach.
This center is responsible for all of our seeking.
Here we will ask,
Mother Kundalini, please remove all desires within me for worldly things which dominate me.
Our beings can often be dominated by our desires for money, for power,
For relationships, but none of these things correspond to our pure spirit.
Mother Kundalini, please remove any desires within me which dominate my spirit.
Mother Kundalini, please awaken within me the seeking for my true self.
We will also remove any other weight or blockages from this left channel
which may stop this power of pure desire from manifesting within us.
Place your right hand upon your heart,
Here you can ask within, Mother Kundalini, please remove anything which weighs upon my heart, please remove any sadness or any insecurities which are closing my heart.
Now place your right hand on the left side of your neck where it joins your shoulder. You can turn your head slightly to the right to be more comfortable.
Here we can ask within, Mother Kundalini, please remove the weight of guilt from within me.
Don't think about anything in particular. Just ask,
Mother Kundalini, please cleanse me of all guilt.
And you can affirm, I am not guilty. I am not guilty.
Now take your right hand and place it across the right side of your head.
This is where your superego lies, which stores all of your conditionings which you have built up over your lifetime.
These conditionings prevent us from truly knowing ourselves.
And from being connected with a higher power. So here we can ask, Mother Kundalini, please cleanse me of all the conditionings which bring me away from my spirit.
Please cleanse me of all conditionings which bring about impure desires.
Now you can take your right palm and place it on the top of your head. Press down firmly, raising your fingertips.
Bring all of your attention to this point at the top of your head.
Here we will once more express the purest desire of all to be connected with the whole,
with the life energy which pervades all the universe, everything around us.
Mother Kundalini, please give me this pure union with the whole.
Please bring me into a blissful state of meditation.
You can raise your hand a few centimeters above your head
and observe anything you may be feeling in your hand.
Is there any coolness?
Any heat or tingling just observe and now bring this hand back into your lap, the palm facing up.
Keep your attention at the top of your head. Just see if you can keep it there for a minute or two.
And if any thoughts come just say, not now.
The more that you do these meditations, the closer you come to your spirit, your true self,
the better you will be able to distinguish between your worldly wants and needs.
And your pure desires, it will just come to you on an instinctive level and thus the experience of meditation will start to flow into your everyday life.
To end this meditation, you can again bring your attention to the top of your head and within, just thank your kundalini for this experience.
And then when you are ready, you can gradually open your eyes.
